company.name: Apollo.io
company.shortDescription: Building the industry’s first fully agentic GTM platform, transforming how revenue teams execute
company.description:
Apollo.io is the company behind the industry’s first fully agentic GTM platform, transforming how revenue teams execute. Going beyond automation, Apollo’s intelligent agents actively drive results across the entire sales funnel - from prospecting to deal management - all in one place. Trusted by millions of users and more than 550K companies, including Autodesk and Cyera, Apollo is making world-class go-to-market simple, intelligent, and accessible for all. 

Visit apollo.io to learn more.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that combines B2B data, prospecting, outreach automation, inbound lead management, sales engagement, and deal execution for revenue teams.

productsAndServices.description: An inbound lead-conversion solution that identifies website visitors, enriches forms, qualifies leads, routes them to representatives, and automates nurture and follow-up.

productsAndServices.description: A sales execution solution for meeting preparation, call recording and summaries, follow-up generation, pipeline management, deal alerts, and conversation analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Deal Execution

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $100,000,000, or 39.79% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $900,000,000 to $1,600,000,000, a 1.78x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 69 (-28 over 90 days) and market heat at 82 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
